t: Erya 爾雅 (www.chinaknowledge.de)
s: Erya 爾雅 "Approach to correct [expressions]" is a dictionary-like glossary from the Han period 漢 (206 BCE-220 CE). It is one of the Thirteen Confucian Classics. The author is not known. Traditionally authorship is attributed to some of Confucius' disciples who compiled the Erya in order to elucidate the meaning of terms appearing in the classical texts.
